mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact symbolic stationary-point, reduced-mass, finite-family, and Jacobian identities for the explicitly proposed one-scalar EFT truncation
mathematics.coefficient_domain: real positive parameters, symbolic SymPy exact arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: hbar=c=1; fixed electron-normalized photon connection; B=1/g^2; QCD Lambda=M_U exp(-a B); a=8 pi^2 k3/b0>0; physical scalar=f x; B(x)=B0+beta x^2/2
inputs: electron mass y M_U exp(-p B)
positive nonrelativistic matter energy n_N m_N+n_e m_e

bounds.finite_family_domain: 0<t<R/(4*pi*kg); any smaller shared valid EFT interval is admitted

non_claims: Does not assert the candidate is part of the canonical framework
Does not calculate complete threshold corrections
Does not determine C or an absolute QCD vacuum energy
Does not prove cosmological attraction or full nonlinear stability
Identities are exact only in the specified leading EFT model
